desc: Prove the V-shape structure using adjacent swaps: eliminate any 0→1 flip before a 1→0 flip, and remove useless extra flips, leaving only optional off/on pairs for common 1s.
Prove the monotonicity/exchange property for common 1s, and define the three categories: Q = 1→0, P = 0→1, K = common 1s; sort K by cost.
Derive the cost for a fixed removed set as DownCost + UpCost, and derive marginal update formulas when inserting one common cost into the descending down set and ascending up set.
Implement the prefix-scan algorithm for the optimal flip schedule: classify positions, sort categories, and scan common 1s from largest to smallest while maintaining the current cost and answer.
Test edge cases such as A = B, only Q, only P, all common, equal costs, and large N, while ensuring O(N log N) time and 64-bit integer arithmetic.
